sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the cost background. You asked what volume we would commit to; the binding volume is set out below. It is our full demand for this part, all placed with you. Our forecast is rising, and a long contract term would give you planning security.

We note your letter of 2026-07-06 says your material is covered at fixed prices, so recent index movements do not yet reach your costs. The data that follows also shows the recent direction of the alloy surcharge and producer prices. Given your forward buying, would you be willing to walk us through your calculation, as your owner once offered?

In return for the price, we offer the full volume and a 36-month term. We can structure the deal either at a fixed price or with the material index applying to its share of the price and a deadband, so that both sides share that risk. Please consider which structure suits you best; our proposal and the supporting data follow.

We confirm a binding volume of 94800 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

The 1.4404 alloy surcharge changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered at fixed prices, so recent index movements do not reach your costs yet.

Our proposal in detail, one of these packages:
- Option A: EUR 4.76 per unit, fixed price, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months
- Option B: EUR 4.71 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for reviewing our offer and moving your proposal. We appreciate the revised terms and your explanation that AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so recent index declines do not affect your current material costs. We also understand your position on keeping your internal calculation models confidential. The index changes you cite, and the basis for your calculation, are addressed in the data that follow.

Our full demand for this part is fixed with you over the term, and our forecast is rising. The 36-month commitment gives you planning security; we are prepared to offer that alongside our full volume. We also note your alternative at 30 days net and €5.58 per unit, and your revised offer at €5.64 with 90 days net. Our last 3 orders were at €5.45, so our proposal moves toward you again while linking only the specified share of the price to AS-14404.

The data below set out the basis for our position, followed by our proposed terms for the full demand.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10, po:4500014305-10).

Our proposal in detail: EUR 5.02 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5.0%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for reviewing our offer and moving your price again. We appreciate the adjustment and understand that your calculation reflects AS-14404, PPI-C2431 and LCI-C. We also recognize that you bought material forward at fixed prices, which shapes your cost position.

Our proposal moves toward you again while reflecting the value we can offer in return: our full demand for this part is fixed with you for the term, and our forecast is rising. The long contract term also provides planning security. In balancing that commitment against the price, we propose linking only part of the price to AS-14404, rather than making the whole price subject to that movement.

You previously offered to walk us through your calculation, and we would welcome that discussion. The data supporting our position follows, then our complete proposal.

In our call of 2026-04-21 (doc:20260421-70710-M2) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.

Our proposal in detail: EUR 5.17 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5.0%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
